The public station handles supplies and dispatch for projects approved by vote. Each city manages its own public warehouses, covers its own support costs, and may call a halt at any time. The supply and housing projects this city has taken on are all in its own departure district.

Vehicle Assignments

Each city has one 4-person service vehicle group. Cities with a completed intermodal freight yard also have one 8-person direct freight train. Vehicles cannot be reassigned until they return to base; intercity transfers are handled in relays by service vehicles along the route.
